title: Occupancy, Bedding and Pet Charges Recorded against the Hotel Rate Plans
content:
Extra occupants, cots, rollaway beds and pets are charged at the figures the Hotel Rate Plans carry. Every amount below is in USD.

| Rate plan | Extra adult, per night | Extra child, per night | Child stays free up to and including age | Cot, per night | Rollaway bed, per night | Pet, whole stay | Heaviest pet accepted, kilograms |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Non-Refundable Saver Rate | 45.0 | 25.0 | 5 | 15.0 | 35.0 | 125.0 | 9 |
| Advance Purchase 21 Rate | 40.0 | 22.0 | 5 | 15.0 | 32.0 | 110.0 | 9 |
| Semi-Flexible Rate | 35.0 | 20.0 | 11 | 12.0 | 30.0 | 95.0 | 14 |
| Standard Flexible Rate | 30.0 | 15.0 | 11 | 0.0 | 25.0 | 85.0 | 18 |
| Member Flex Rate | 25.0 | 12.0 | 12 | 0.0 | 25.0 | 75.0 | 18 |
| Suite Flexible Rate | 0.0 | 0.0 | 12 | 0.0 | 0.0 | 150.0 | 23 |
| All-Inclusive Flex Rate | 85.0 | 55.0 | 12 | 0.0 | 0.0 | 175.0 | 23 |

## Column notes

The **extra adult** and **extra child** amounts are per additional occupant per night beyond the standard occupancy the rate carries. The **free age limit** is the age up to and including which a child stays free in the parents' room. The **cot** and **rollaway** amounts are per night. The **pet** amount is charged once for the whole stay, and the **weight limit** is the heaviest pet the plan accepts.

## Points of judgement

*Where an amount is 0.0.* The Suite Flexible Rate records 0.0 for extra adults, extra children, cots and rollaway beds alike; the Standard Flexible Rate and the Member Flex Rate record 0.0 for the cot only; the All-Inclusive Flex Rate records 0.0 for the cot and the rollaway bed but the highest extra-occupant amounts of any plan, 85.0 USD and 55.0 USD.

*Where the age limit falls.* A child of 11 is inside the free limit on the Semi-Flexible Rate, the Standard Flexible Rate, the Member Flex Rate, the Suite Flexible Rate and the All-Inclusive Flex Rate, and outside it on the Non-Refundable Saver Rate and the Advance Purchase 21 Rate, both of which record 5. A child of 12 is inside the limit only on the Member Flex Rate, the Suite Flexible Rate and the All-Inclusive Flex Rate.

*A worked reading.* One extra adult for 4 nights on the Standard Flexible Rate, at the 30.0 USD this schedule records for that plan, comes to 120.00 USD.
